name: ryu.dashboards
description: Dashboards: composable widget boards that assemble live views from Composio actions, guarded HTTPS endpoints, and inline data. Declares the out-of-process ryu-dashboards sidecar (kind:local) that owns the store + refresh loop + /api/dashboards/* surface, served to the desktop through the generic ext-proxy public_mount. Started eagerly (not lazy) so the kernel hardware device-dashboard renderer + nudge loop can reach it at boot / on a device poll before any desktop has opened Home. The dashboard_builder MCP runnable and the hardware render seam reach it only through the dashboards.* capabilities it provides.
